drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy without CC/MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Chest x-ray: pulmonary vascular congestion, small bilateral effusions

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 45-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.69, bnp 1112, creatinine 1.1, hemoglobin 13.4, platelets 218, sodium 140, wbc 7.7; vitals dbp 72-76, heart_rate 76-78, map 88-91, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 119-124, spo2 96-97, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: pulmonary vascular congestion, small bilateral effusions; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Furosemide 40 mg IV; Transthoracic echo: LVEF 28%, global hypokinesis
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. CHF.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.09, hemoglobin 13.5, platelets 224, sodium 141, wbc 7.6; vitals dbp 70-75, heart_rate 76-81, map 87-90, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 118-125, spo2 96-97, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Furosemide 40 mg IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. CHF. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 45-year-old female, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. CHF. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
